2239-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2239-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6155-8337.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
1479-2841-6155-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

413-4336-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
413-4336-5006-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

323-789-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
323-789-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

877-2292-3184-4645.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing The First Sliver.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Viscera Seer trigger.
Cast The First Sliver by paying {0}.
The First Sliver's cascade ability triggers, allowing you to cascade.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

requires.n: Legendary Creature Castable for One Mana of Any Color

3184-4050--191.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the legendary creature, adding one mana.
When that creature dies, Yomiji triggers, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-3756-7889.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Dancing from Dark to Dawn, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

104-440-5796-7426.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
104-440-5796-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
104-440-5796-7426.description:
Draw a card.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Well of Lost Dreams and Cleric Class trigger.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams ability, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1245-1475-4535.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
1245-1475-4535.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirit token(s) enter, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers that many times, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Spirit.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token.
When the Carnivore token enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Carnivore token.
Repeat.

3227-5195-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Scrivener
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Scrivener
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

216-1618-2440-7375.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings
216-1618-2440-7375.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Arc Blade.
Arc Blade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Metallurgic Summonings triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Arc Blade.
Repeat.
216-1618-2440-7375.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Metallurgic Summonings. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

647-3259-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
647-3259-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

876-4668-7070.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
876-4668-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat.

1809-1987-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1809-1987-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-3490-7075-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-3490-7075-7175.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2919-5086-5183-5231-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-5086-5183-5231-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

2457-4289-6441-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

4050-5660-6690.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sparring Construct, adding {1}.
When Sparring Construct dies, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sparring Construct from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sparring Construct by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1580-2438-4871-5542.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1636-3457-5970-6219.notablePrerequisites:
Ritual Chamber is locked.
Marina and Seeker of Skybreak do not have summoning sickness.
1636-3457-5970-6219.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Ritual Chamber.
Ritual Chamber triggers, creating a 6/6 Demon creature token with flying.
When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

4094-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
4094-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
4094-5478-5702-5954.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
Repeat from step 4.

4050-4675-4681-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}, targeting Karmic Guide in your graveyard. 
Animate Dead triggers, returning Karmic Guide to the battlefield.
Karmic Guide triggers, returning Cavalier of Dawn from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cavalier of Dawn enters, it triggers itself, targeting nothing.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding {B}.
Animate Dead is put into your graveyard as a state-based action.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cavalier of Dawn, adding {B}.
Cavalier of Dawn's last ability triggers, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4050-4675-4681-4812.notes: Optionally, you may use Cavalier of Dawn's ETB ability infinite times, destroying any number of nonland permanents and giving their controllers a 3/3 Golem for each one destroyed.

116-1974-2569.notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Gargantuan is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Quicksilver Gargantuan do not have summoning sickness.
116-1974-2569.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Quicksilver Gargantuan.
Activate Quicksilver Gargantuan by tapping it.
When Quicksilver Gargantuan becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Quicksilver Gargantuan's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1267-2719-5658.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-2719-5658.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker.
Satya triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of Medomai the Ageless, and causing you to get {E}{E}.
Deal combat damage using the Medomai the Ageless token.
The Medomai the Ageless token triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Medomai the Ageless token.
Repeat each turn.

2060-2757-4687.manaNeeded: {1} if you control a basic Forest and/or Island, or {G/U} available otherwise
2060-2757-4687.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
You control at least one basic land.
2060-2757-4687.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Gilder Bairn, untapping the basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanent(s).

719-3665-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact.
You have at least three opponents.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
719-3665-4508.description:
Activate Penregon Strongbull by paying {1} and sacrificing an artifact, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Malcolm triggers for each opponent dealt damage this way, creating that many Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

719-2353-2395-4508.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2353-2395-4508.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Quicksmith Genius, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

283-890-2722-3007.notablePrerequisites:
Magewright's Stone, Toymaker and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
283-890-2722-3007.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Toymaker by paying {1}, tapping it and discarding a card, causing Magewright's Stone to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Illusionist's Bracers' equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to Magewright's Stone.
Activate Magewright's Stone by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Magewright's Stone abillity, targeting Palladium Myr.
Resolve both Magewright's Stone abilities, untapping Magewright's Stone and Palladium Myr.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4.

1750-3743-4636-5261.description:
Activate Osgir's second ability by paying {6}, tapping it and exiling Gonti's Aether Heart from your graveyard, creating two token copies of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Put one of the Gonti's Aether Hearts into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Gonti's Aether Hearts' enters-the-battlefield ability trigger twice, adding a total of eight {E}.
Activate the remaining Gonti's Aether Heart by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Gonti's Aether Heart into your graveyard from exile.
Repeat each turn.

1309-1987-2427.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1309-1987-2427.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.

215-647-3291-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least three +1/+1 counters.
215-647-3291-3771.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying {G}.
Repeat.
